verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev documents a run page with a real-time trace view of each executing task plus its logs, and a configurable runs list with smart columns that pull payload or output values by JSON path, so a per-run timeline and dashboard exist. The evidence does not show per-step inputs, outputs, retries and errors inside that timeline, and filtering is only shown through the SDK's runs.list status filter, not the dashboard. Missing for 10: documented per-step input/output/retry/error detail in the trace view, explicit dashboard search and filter, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, every run has a step-by-step timeline — inputs, outputs, retries, and errors per step — in a dashboard my team can search and filter

citations.quote: As soon as you trigger a task, the run page will show a trace view of each task executing in real-time along with any logs it produces.
add smart columns that pull a value out of a run's payload, metadata, or output by JSON path
